parameter_help.tempo: Speed in beats per minute. 60 is a slow ballad, 120 a pop song, 180+ punk or metal.
parameter_help.signature: Time signature: beats per bar over the note value that counts as one beat. 4/4 is the default, 3/4 a waltz, 6/8 a compound lilt.
parameter_help.scale: The set of notes everything is drawn from. Major sounds bright, natural_minor dark, blues gritty, pentatonic_* safe and open.
parameter_help.tonic: The note the scale is built on, and the note a closed phrase comes home to.
parameter_help.tonic_octave: Register of the tonic. 4 puts middle C at the bottom of the scale; lower it for a darker part, raise it for a brighter one.
parameter_help.beat_mode: The grid the melody is written on. Fixed 16th gives the same rhythmic detail in any signature; half-beat follows the signature instead.
parameter_help.filename: Default name offered when the piece is saved as a .mid file.
parameter_help.bars: Length of this section, in bars.
parameter_help.rhythm: Drum pattern genre for this section.
parameter_help.drums_enabled: Which drums of the pattern actually play. Strip it down for an intro, restore everything for a chorus.
parameter_help.roles: Which instrument plays each role. A support instrument doubles part of its role's main line.
parameter_help.lead_rest_prob: Chance that a slot in the melody is silent instead of a note. 0 is a wall of notes, 0.3 leaves plenty of air.
parameter_help.lead_sustain: How much of its slot a melody note actually sounds for. Below 1 leaves a gap before the next note; above 1 overlaps them.
parameter_help.lead_velocity_jitter: Random loudness variation per melody note. This is humanisation only - the musical emphasis comes from Metric Accent.
parameter_help.lead_step_bias: How often the melody steps to a neighbouring scale note instead of leaping. High values sing, low values skitter.
parameter_help.bass_gate: How much of its beat a bass note sounds for. Lower values make the bass shorter and punchier.
parameter_help.chord_gate: How much of its span a chord sounds for. Lower values let the chords breathe between strikes.
parameter_help.chord_octave_shift: How far below the melody the chords are voiced, in octaves. -2 is the default; -1 crowds the tune, -3 opens a gap.
parameter_help.phrase_bars: Length of a phrase, in bars. 0 chooses one for you: half the section, at most four bars. Phrases alternate question and answer.
parameter_help.metric_accent: How much louder the downbeat is than a plain beat, in MIDI velocity. 0 switches metric emphasis off entirely.
parameter_help.intensity: Velocity multiplier for the whole section. Use it to make an intro quieter and a chorus louder than the verse.
parameter_help.final_lengthening: How much the last note of each phrase is stretched. 1.0 is off; performers naturally slow into a phrase ending.
parameter_help.lead_syncopation: How often the melody is pushed off the beat, and how often a long note ties across one. 0 stays square.
parameter_help.cadence_beats: How many beats at the end of each phrase are reshaped into its cadence.
parameter_help.auto_cadence: Give every phrase an ending: a question (open, on an unstable note over the fifth) then an answer (closed, on the tonic).
parameter_help.drum_fills: Play a fill into every phrase boundary and crash on the landing.
parameter_help.expression: Write performance data as well as notes: reverb and chorus sends, swells within a phrase, pitch bends, slides and vibrato.
